CustomField.description: One short sentence in the owner's own voice, shown on the home page hero under the name. Read by ResumeController.getHeader from the portfolio owner Contact. Blank shows nothing. The longer Career Objective stays on the resume.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: One sentence, at most 160 characters, written by the owner. Not a title or a slogan. Leave blank to show no line on the home page.
CustomField.label: Hero Line
